PhD & EngD at CEM
PhD & EngD at CEM
Within our department it is possible to follow post graduate trajectories via PhD or EngD programmes
You can follow a PhD training trajectory to become an independent researcher. You will design, plan and execute your own research project on a specific topic in close cooperation with your supervisors. Being responsible for your own research allows you to investigate the topics you find most interesting within the scope of the original project proposal. In our group it takes 4 year training on the job and can be divided roughly in three parts: 77.5% of research, 12.5% of education (6 months) and 10% teaching.
PhD trajectory at the University of Twente
Or follow the two years lasting EngD programme in Civil Engineering that combines academic research in a professional context with education in a range of related subjects. It consists of three blocks: a block of professional development, a block with in-depth and broadening courses and a technological design project.
EngD programme in Civil Engineering
